snippet.title: Going Medieval - Official Version 1.0 Release Date Trailer | IGN Fan Fest 2026
snippet.description:
Take a look back at Going Medieval's early access journey, and get a peek at what's ahead in version 1.0, in this latest trailer for the strategy city builder game. The new Going Medieval trailer showcases the Early Access updates, including the addition of water, fire, deep terraforming, trading, wildlife & taming, bandit camps, prisoners, siege weapons, advanced castle building, and modding. Going Medieval leaves Early Access, and version 1.0 launches on PC (GOG, Steam, and Epic Games Store) on March 12, 2026. A demo is out now on Steam.

Build and manage your own castle settlement in a land reclaimed by wilderness. With detailed management, survival strategy, and a moddable sandbox world, Going Medieval challenges you to build the mightiest colony this side of the apocalypse.
